title: SlideCast Bundle Builder — how to use it
subtitle: Slides, script, AI voice and mic recordings, prepared in one pass and packed into a Bundle ZIP
description: How to use SlideCast Bundle Builder, the companion tool for SlideCast Studio: prepare your slides, generate a script, add AI voice or record your own, validate everything, and export a Bundle ZIP.
author: aokuma

overview.title: Everything your video needs, prepared in one place

blocks.html:
SlideCast Bundle Builder is a Gemini Canvas app that prepares the slides, script and audio you will later load into SlideCast Studio. Create the slides on the spot or bring your own files, work through the script and the audio, then export the whole set as a Bundle ZIP.

For audio you can use Gemini TTS, your own voice through the microphone, or both. Generate everything with AI, record everything yourself, or record just the few lines you want in your own voice.

blocks.title: Try Bundle Builder
blocks.text: The app opens from a Gemini share link. Do not upload material that contains confidential or personal information.
blocks.label: Open in Gemini

cards.title: Prepare the slides
cards.text: Create them inside Canvas, or load images, PDFs, ZIPs or a folder.

cards.title: Generate the script
cards.text: Set the audience, the length, the number of speakers, the dialogue style.

cards.title: Generate AI voice
cards.text: Pick a voice per speaker and generate all at once, or slide by slide.

cards.title: Record your own voice
cards.text: Read from the on-screen script and trim both ends on the waveform.

cards.title: Validate
cards.text: Catch mismatches between script, speakers, audio and slide references before export.

cards.title: Import as a ZIP
cards.text: Export the Bundle ZIP and load it into “Create from documents” in SlideCast Studio.

sections.title: The shape of the whole thing
sections.intro: Five steps, in order. At the end you have a complete set of material to finish in SlideCast Studio.

items.title: Create or upload the slides
items.text: Generate slide images inside Canvas, or load material you already have.

items.title: Generate and edit the script
items.text: Choose the conditions that fit your purpose, then prepare the script for each slide.

items.title: Generate or record the audio
items.text: Use Gemini TTS, your own voice, or a mix of the two.

items.title: Validate the data
items.text: Check how the script, speakers, audio and slides refer to each other.

items.title: Export the Bundle ZIP
items.text: Load the finished ZIP into SlideCast Studio, adjust the staging and the audio, then export the video.

sections.title: Create or upload the slides
sections.intro: You can build a new deck from scratch, or start from material you already have.

before.label: Create them here
before.text: Give a topic, an audience and an art direction, and the slide images are generated inside Canvas.

after.label: Use your own
after.text: Load PNG, JPEG, PDF, ZIP or a folder and start from an existing deck.

blocks.alt: The Bundle Builder upload screen, accepting PNG, JPEG, PDF, ZIP and folders
blocks.caption: Loaded material appears as thumbnails, and you can reorder the slides before generating the script

blocks.title: If you plan to record, allow the microphone first
blocks.text: In Gemini Canvas the app may reload the first time you grant microphone access. If recording is on your list, finish the microphone check on the home screen before you load any material.

blocks.alt: The check and allow microphone button on the Bundle Builder home screen
blocks.caption: If you only use Gemini TTS, there is no need to allow the microphone at all

sections.title: Generate a script that fits the job
sections.intro: The defaults work fine, but naming your audience and your tone gets you much closer to what you actually want.

blocks.alt: Bundle Builder script settings, with target audience, number of speakers and subtitle layout
blocks.caption: Target audience, script style, length, number of speakers, subtitle layout and more

items: Target audience, plus any extra conditions
Script style — explanatory, persuasive and so on
1–6 speakers and how they talk to each other

blocks.alt: The ready-to-generate screen, offering automatic generation, a prompt for external AI, and script JSON import
blocks.caption: Besides generating inside Canvas, you can take a prompt to an external AI or import script JSON

blocks.title: You can write the script with a different AI
blocks.text: Hand the displayed prompt and the same material to any AI you like, get script JSON back, and import it into Bundle Builder. The prompt already carries the file names and the slide order.

sections.intro: Pick a voice per speaker, then generate everything at once or try one slide at a time.

items: Preview and choose a voice for each speaker
Generate audio for every slide at once
Generate or regenerate a single slide

blocks.title: Whether you need an API key depends on the model
blocks.text: The default setup works without an API key, but some models — newer ones in particular — may require a Gemini API key. Model names and availability can change.

blocks.alt: The microphone recording button in the audio row of a slide in Bundle Builder
blocks.caption: The microphone button on each slide replaces just that line with your own voice

sections.title: Record your own voice and trim it
sections.intro: The script is shown on the recording screen, so reading, checking and accepting all happen in one place.

items.title: Record
items.text: Start and stop while reading the subtitle script on screen.

items.title: Check the waveform
items.text: See how long the take is and where the sound actually sits.

items.title: Trim both ends
items.text: Drag the handles to cut silence, button clicks and false starts.

items.title: Preview or re-record
items.text: Listen to the trimmed take and record again if it is not right.

items.title: Accept it
items.text: Set the take as the audio for that slide.

blocks.alt: The Bundle Builder recording screen with the subtitle script, elapsed time, waveform trimming, preview, re-record and accept buttons
blocks.caption: Trim against the waveform, listen back, and accept only when it sounds right

blocks.title: If the slide already has generated audio
blocks.text: Where Gemini TTS audio is already set, you are asked to confirm before the recording overwrites it.

sections.title: Validate, then import the ZIP
sections.intro: Run the pre-export check, then load the Bundle ZIP into SlideCast Studio.

blocks.alt: The Bundle Builder validation screen, showing check results for script, speakers, audio links and slide references
blocks.caption: Mismatches surface before the ZIP is written, not after it has been imported

blocks.alt: The Bundle Builder ZIP export screen, producing a package SlideCast Studio can import
blocks.caption: Once everything is in place, write out the Bundle ZIP

blocks.alt: The SlideCast Studio dashboard with “Create from documents” highlighted as the place to upload the Bundle ZIP
blocks.caption: In the SlideCast Studio dashboard, choose “Create from documents” and load the ZIP as it is

blocks.title: The audio stays adjustable after import
blocks.text: Both Gemini TTS audio and your recordings can have their speed and pitch adjusted inside SlideCast Studio. The new length is reflected on the timeline, and you can always go back to the original.

sections.title: Worth knowing before you begin
sections.intro: The tool depends on Gemini’s availability and on browser permissions, so read this part first.

items.title: No confidential material
items.text: Do not upload material containing confidential information, personal data or anything internal to your company.

items.title: Back off when limited
items.text: Repeated 429 errors or failures usually mean a usage limit. Wait rather than retrying in quick succession.

items.title: Models change
items.text: Model names, speed and availability for script generation and TTS can change without notice.

items.title: API key only when needed
items.text: The defaults need none, but some models require a Google AI Studio API key.

items.title: Microphone is optional
items.text: Allow it only if you record. AI voice alone needs no microphone access.

items.title: Careful with very long decks
items.text: A large number of slides or a very long script can fail. Split the work when it does.

blocks.title: Changes on Google’s side can change how this behaves
blocks.text: Bundle Builder is a companion tool running on Gemini Canvas. Specification changes, outages or usage limits on Google’s side can make it behave differently from what is described here.

items.q: Is it unusable if I don’t allow the microphone?
items.a: No. Everything except mic recording, Gemini TTS included, works without it.

items.q: Can AI voice and recordings be mixed?
What if script generation doesn’t go well?
items.a: Use the prompt for external AI, build the script JSON elsewhere, and import it into Bundle Builder.

items.q: Where does the exported ZIP go?
items.a: Upload it to “Create from documents” on the SlideCast Studio dashboard.
